dialogues.speaker: Ami
dialogues.text: Is it really fun? What's so fun about cooking out in the open?

dialogues.speaker: Ami
dialogues.text: And what if a bug falls into the pot? That's not fun at all...

dialogues.speaker: Ami
dialogues.text: That would be a pity, for the bug, also for the grown-ups who eat the food with the bug in it. It's not worth it at all.
